content_zh:
叶小天正贼眉鼠眼地打量杨霖的漂亮女儿，察觉有些异样，这才扭过头去，就见一个披麻带孝的老妇人正与一个拄着拐杖、拢着耳朵的白发老头说着话，在场众人显然是以他二人为中心。
那个老头儿看起来已经有七八十了，满脸皱纹，白发苍苍，手中拄着一根色泽金黄的藤杖，正是靖州杨家的老族长，杨夫人与他大声耳语了几句，便转向众人，朗声道：“各位亲朋好友，老身有话要说。”
杨夫人冷冷地扫了一眼叶小天和那个脸色苍白一脸惊怒的女子，对满堂宾客道：“拙夫亡故，劳烦各位宾朋前来吊唁，妾身感激不尽。可是就在为拙夫守孝期间，这个贱婢……”
杨夫人伸手一指那姿容清丽、身段婉约的女子，咬牙切齿地道：“这个贱婢竟然在为拙夫守孝期间，大逆不道，与人私通，行那苟且之事！”
一言既出，就如平地一声惊雷，满堂宾客顿时哗然一片，纷纷看向那个女子，脸上现出鄙夷之极。
那清媚女子惊愕的瞪大了一双漂亮的眼睛，似乎没有想到杨夫人竟然给她编排了一个如此不堪的罪名。惊愕地看着杨夫人，忽然间她便泪流满面，哽咽愤怒地道：“我没有，我没有！你冤枉我！”
杨夫人冷笑连连，根本不接她的话碴儿，只是对杨老族长道：“此事有府上管事与家丁为证，奸夫淫妇乃当场拿获，若非如此，妾身岂会如此自污，令家门蒙羞？
老族长，妾身如今已将这对奸夫淫妇拿下，这是我杨家的事，更是我杨氏家族的事，拙夫已然不在，妾身一介妇道人家，如何处置，还要请族长大人您示下。”
老族长拢着耳朵，声若洪钟地道：“啊？老六家的，你说啥？你家的门怎么着啦？你大着点声，我听不清。”
叶小天万万没有想到这位杨夫人居然问都不问就给他定了罪名。一刹那间，他就明白了杨夫人的毒计，没想到这位杨夫人不仅嗜财如命，而且心眼儿如此之小，只因丈夫宠爱妾室，只因她一无所出，那妾室却为丈夫生下一个女儿，他就如此嫉恨，竟然想置这妾生女于死地方才罢休。
耳背的杨家老族长还在扯着嗓门问：“她说啥？绑了她作啥？她把你家的府门给弄坏了？”
叶小天直接脖子大吼：“杨夫人！这完全是一派胡言，你可不要信口雌黄，我叶小天和这位小娘子素昧平生，根本就不认识，哪里来的奸情？”
杨夫人其实也不大相信这个外地口音的小子是个奸夫，却想趁此机会除掉她的眼中钉，所以并不问他，只是冷笑道：“你说没有就没有？三瘦，告诉大家，你在哪儿抓到他的。”
杨三瘦马上近前两步，向众人道：“各位老爷，小的是杨府管事杨三瘦，这人鬼鬼祟祟潜入杨府，与那贱婢幽会，两人正在宽衣解带之际，适逢小的去送月例银子，可巧儿发现了，这才把他们捉来，交予夫人处置。”
叶小天大声道：“不错，我当时确实在这小娘子房中……不是，院中！不过，我可不是与这位小娘子有私情，我到那院中时，还不曾与她通名报姓，我实是有一件大事要告诉她。”
杨氏夫人微微一怔，虽然急于置那女子死地，依旧掩不住好奇之心，忍不住问道：“什么大事？”
叶小天睨了她一眼，昂然道：“今日杨家有四方宾客远来，不知可有官场上的人物？我这件大事，一定要当着官府的人说出来，否则只怕有人不能秉公而断呢。”
杨氏夫人大怒道：“你若光明磊落，何事不可对人言？”
叶小天冷笑道：“我自然是光明磊落的，可是我早风闻你杨夫人的为人了，若是不经公门，谁知你会不会一手遮天。”
叶小天这番话自然也勾起了一众来宾的好奇，堂上堂下顿时一片窃窃私语声，自打到了厅堂就随意站在一边的那位襕衫老者突然微微一笑，踏前两步，缓声道：“本官乃靖州知县胡括，你有什么话，对本官说吧！”

叶小天怔了一怔，上下打量他两眼，迟疑道：“你当真是本地的知县大老爷？”
胡括脸色微沉，拂然不悦：“混帐！青天白日、众目睽睽之下，难道这官府中人也是随便冒充的？还是说，你根本就是无话可说，所以胡搅蛮缠，意图拖延时间。嗯？”

content_en:
Ye Xiaotian was looking at Yang Lin's beautiful daughter with a stern look, and noticed something strange. Then he turned his head and saw an old woman in linen and filial piety talking to a white-haired old man on crutches with his ears folded. Everyone present was obviously centered on the two of them.
The old man looked to be in his seventies or eighties, with a wrinkled face and gray hair. He was holding a golden cane in his hand. He was the old patriarch of the Yang family in Jingzhou. Mrs. Yang whispered a few loud words to him, then turned to the crowd and said loudly: "Dear relatives and friends, I have something to say."
Mrs. Yang glanced coldly at Ye Xiaotian and the pale and angry woman, and said to the guests in the hall: "My husband has passed away. I would like to thank all of you for coming to express your condolences. But while I am keeping my filial piety for my husband, this lowly maid..."
Mrs. Yang pointed at the beautiful and graceful woman, and said through gritted teeth, "This wretched servant turned out to be treasonous, had an affair with others, and did such shady things while she was keeping her filial piety for her humble husband!"
As soon as the words were spoken, it was like a thunder on the ground, and the guests in the hall suddenly burst into an uproar. They all looked at the woman with contempt on their faces.
The pretty woman's beautiful eyes widened in shock, as if she didn't expect that Mrs. Yang would fabricate such an unbearable crime for her. Looking at Mrs. Yang in shock, she suddenly burst into tears and said angrily, choked with sobs: "I didn't, I didn't! You wronged me!"
Mrs. Yang sneered repeatedly and did not answer her words at all. She just said to Patriarch Yang: "This matter was proved by the stewards and servants of the house. The adulterer and adulterer were caught on the spot. If not, how could I have defiled myself like this and brought shame to the family?
Old Patriarch, I have now captured this pair of adulterers and adulterers. This is a matter for my Yang family, and even more so for my Yang family. My husband is no longer here, and I am a woman from a Taoist family. I would like to ask the Patriarch to tell me how to deal with it. "
The old patriarch closed his ears and said in a loud voice: "Ah? Lao Liu's family, what are you talking about? Why is your door locked? Please speak louder, I can't hear you clearly."
Ye Xiaotian never expected that Mrs. Yang would convict him without even asking. In an instant, he understood Mrs. Yang's vicious plan. He did not expect that Mrs. Yang was not only greedy for money, but also so small-minded. Just because her husband doted on her concubine, and just because she had nothing to do, the concubine gave birth to a daughter for her husband. He was so jealous that he wanted to put the concubine's daughter to death.
The deaf old patriarch of the Yang family was still asking in a loud voice: "What did she say? Why did you tie her up? Did she damage the door of your house?"
Ye Xiaotian yelled directly on his neck: "Mrs. Yang! This is complete nonsense. Don't talk nonsense. I, Ye Xiaotian, and this young lady have never met each other. We don't know each other at all. Where did the adultery come from?"
In fact, Mrs. Yang didn't really believe that this boy with a foreign accent was an adulterer, but she wanted to take this opportunity to get rid of a thorn in her side, so she didn't ask him, but just sneered: "You said no, why don't you? Sanshou, tell everyone where you caught him."
Yang Sanshou immediately took two steps forward and said to everyone: "Masters, the younger one is Yang Sanshou, the steward of the Yang Mansion. This man sneaked into the Yang Mansion and had a tryst with that cheap maid. When the two of them were undressing and taking off their belts, the younger one happened to go to deliver the monthly silver. Coincidentally, they were discovered, so they were captured and handed over to the madam."
Ye Xiaotian said loudly: "Yes, I was indeed in the young lady's room at that time... no, in the courtyard! However, I did not have an affair with this young lady. When I arrived in the courtyard, I had not known her by name. I really have something important to tell her."
Mrs. Yang was slightly startled. Although she was eager to put the woman to death, she still couldn't hide her curiosity. She couldn't help but ask: "What's the big deal?"
Ye Xiaotian glanced at her and said proudly: "Today, the Yang family has guests from all over the world. I wonder if there is any officialdom?"The characters on it? This important matter of mine must be spoken out in front of the officials, otherwise I am afraid that someone will not be able to judge it impartially. "
Mrs. Yang said angrily: "If you are upright and aboveboard, why can't you tell others? "
Ye Xiaotian sneered and said: "Of course I am aboveboard, but I have already heard about your character, Mrs. Yang. If you don't go through the public, who knows whether you will be able to cover up the sky with one hand. "
Ye Xiaotian's words naturally aroused the curiosity of all the guests. There was a sudden murmur in the hall. The old man in a ruffled shirt who had been standing casually on the side since arriving in the hall suddenly smiled, took two steps forward, and said slowly: "I am Hu Kuo, the magistrate of Jingzhou. If you have anything to say, tell me!" "
Ye Xiaotian was stunned for a moment, looked him up and down, and said hesitantly: "Are you really the local magistrate? "
Hu Kuo's face darkened slightly, and he said with a hint of displeasure: "Damn it! Under the clear sky and in full view of the public, could it be that this person in the government just pretended to be someone else? Or, you simply have nothing to say, so you are messing around in an attempt to delay time. Um? "
